title: Contract Pricing Agreement Price Basis Terms: Discounts, Cost-Plus Markup and Unit Price Precision
content:
# Price basis terms by tier

These are the Contract Pricing Agreement tier terms that set a discount-based or cost-plus price, and the precision every unit price carries. Which basis applies to a given billed line is decided by the price basis rule of the agreement; this page carries the figures.

Columns, lowest tier to highest: **Account Price Schedule** = Corbett Account Price Schedule; **Volume Discount** = Corbett Volume Discount Agreement; **Category Contract** = Corbett Category Contract; **Net-Price** = Corbett Net-Price Contract; **Cost-Plus** = Corbett Cost-Plus Contract; **Strategic Supply** = Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement.

## Discount, markup and precision terms

| Term | Account Price Schedule | Volume Discount | Category Contract | Net-Price | Cost-Plus | Strategic Supply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat discount off Corbett list price for catalog items with no category discount and no contract item price (percent); 0 means not used | 5 | 8 | 10 | 12 | 0 | 15 |
| Largest category discount the tier may carry in its schedule (percent) | 0 | 15 | 25 | 30 | 0 | 35 |
| Cost-plus markup over Corbett's current supplier cost (percent); 0 means the tier is not cost-plus | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 0 |
| Minimum markup per unit on cost-plus items (USD); 0 means not used | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.05 | 0.00 |
| Notice before a supplier cost increase changes a cost-plus price (calendar days); 0 means not used | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 0 |
| Special-order markup over supplier cost for non-stock special-order items not on the contract (percent) | 25 | 22 | 20 | 18 | 12 | 15 |
| List price quantity breaks apply before the discount on list-discount items | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Decimal places every contract and computed unit price is rounded to (half up) | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Date that selects the price in effect for a billed line | ship date | ship date | ship date | ship date | ship date | ship date |

## Category discount schedule (percent off list)

A category marked "not listed" takes the tier's flat list discount. A tier with no listed category carries no category discounts.

| Product category | Account Price Schedule | Volume Discount | Category Contract | Net-Price | Cost-Plus | Strategic Supply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fasteners | not listed | 12% | 20% | 22% | not listed | 25% |
| Abrasives | not listed | 10% | 18% | 20% | not listed | 22% |
| Safety and PPE | not listed | 8% | 15% | 16% | not listed | 18% |
| Janitorial | not listed | 10% | 16% | not listed | not listed | 20% |
| Cutting tools | not listed | 10% | 18% | 20% | not listed | 22% |
| Bearings and power transmission | not listed | not listed | 12% | 14% | not listed | 15% |
| Electrical | not listed | not listed | 10% | 12% | not listed | 14% |
| Lighting | not listed | not listed | 14% | not listed | not listed | 16% |
| Hand and power tools | not listed | not listed | not listed | not listed | not listed | 12% |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

An item with a hypothetical list price of 20.0000 in a category discounted at 10 percent carries 20.0000 less 10 percent of it, which is 18.0000, rounded half up to four decimal places. On a cost-plus tier with a hypothetical markup of 10 percent and a minimum markup of 0.10 per unit, an item with a supplier cost of 0.5000 takes the higher of 0.5000 increased by 10 percent (0.5500) and 0.5000 plus 0.10 (0.6000), which is 0.6000. These inputs are illustrative and are not tier figures.
